justification: Inspected `byte-buddy-benchmark/src/main/java/net/bytebuddy/benchmark/SuperClassInvocationBenchmark.java` (370 LOC, one `setUp()` plus a focused set of benchmark methods around a single benchmark concern) and `byte-buddy-benchmark/pom.xml` (JMH annotation processor dependency at lines 50-54 and `net.bytebuddy.benchmark.jmh_generated` excluded from javadoc at lines 117-120). The repository does not contain a tracked source file for the generated `...jmhTest` class, and the available evidence points to generated JMH scaffolding rather than a hand-written, multi-responsibility class with insufficient modularization.
